root.name: オプション・ケア・ヘルス

rows.ja: 競合(相手の資料に記載)

relations.text: 前身のOption CareはWalgreensの点滴事業を2015年に買い取って生まれた
relations.text_en: Its predecessor Option Care was formed from Walgreens Infusion Services, bought in 2015

source.label: Option Care Health 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: collectively acquired Walgreens Infusion Services, Inc. and its subsidiaries from Walgreen Co., and the business was rebranded as Option Care, Inc. ("Option Care").

relations.text: 10-Kで、在宅点滴の競合として名指し(Optum Infusion Pharmacy)
relations.text_en: Named in its 10-K as a home infusion competitor (Optum Infusion Pharmacy)

source.label: Option Care Health 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The Company's competitors within the home infusion market include Optum Infusion Pharmacy (a unit of UnitedHealth Group), Coram CVS/specialty infusion services (a division of CVS Health), Amerita Specialty Pharmacy (a division of BrightSpring Health), KabaFusion, Soleo Health, Vital Care

companies.name: ブライトスプリング・ヘルス・サービシズ

relations.text: BrightSpringが10-Kで、在宅点滴・専門薬局の競合の筆頭に挙げる(本人の10-KもBrightSpring傘下のAmeritaを挙げる)
relations.text_en: BrightSpring lists it first among home infusion rivals (its own 10-K names BrightSpring's Amerita too)

source.label: BrightSpring 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In our infusion and specialty pharmacy services, we compete in the large and fragmented home infusion and specialty pharmacy markets including Option Care Health, Inc., Coram CVS/specialty infusion services (a division of CVS Health), Accredo Health Group, Inc.

relations.text: DocGoが10-Kで、大手の在宅・遠隔医療の競合として挙げる
relations.text_en: DocGo names it among larger in-home and telehealth competitors

source.label: DocGo 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Major competitors (in each case relative to only some of our products or services) include much larger, national or regional telehealth or in-home healthcare service providers such as DispatchHealth, Modivcare, Option Care Health
